summary: Issue already addressed - existing code correctly handles None timestamps. Regression tests added in commit b109047 verify the correct behavior.
notes: The existing implementation in todo.py already correctly handles None timestamps. The expression `data.get('created_at') or ''` returns empty string when value is None, and __post_init__ generates a new timestamp for empty strings. Tests verify: (1) None creates valid ISO timestamp, (2) empty string creates valid ISO timestamp, (3) explicit timestamp is preserved, (4) updated_at also works correctly.
